description: Run one exact-match query against a schema from list_schemas. Pass schema plus optional filter (keys from get_schema.filterable) and fields. This is the only query tool — do not invent query_tickets, query_assets, or query_with_filter. Empty rows mean no match; loosen the filter, do not retry the identical query.

fields.description: Optional field projection. Example: ["id","subject"]. Omit to return all fields.

filter.description: Optional exact-match map. Keys must be listed in get_schema.filterable. Example: {"status":"open"}.

limit.description: Max rows to return. Default 10, max 50.

schema.description: One of tickets, customers, assets — from list_schemas. Do not invent a name.

name: run_query
